audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer never names a single Kayle ability. It says she has "no way to punish me", "zero kill pressure back" and "no tool to trade back at level 2". Radiant Blast is a 900-range piercing projectile on 12/11/10/9/8s that slows AND reduces the resistances of everything it hits, and Starfire Spellblade is an 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s auto-attack reset whose bonus damage scales with the target's MISSING health.
audit.why: Both claims are wrong in the direction that gets a Jayce killed. She out-ranges nothing with autos, but Radiant Blast reaches 900 — further than Shock Blast's own step-up range — and the resist shred means the trade she wants is Q-slow into a Starfire Spellblade reset on a Jayce who has already poked himself low on his own Doran's. The missing-health scaling makes her strongest at exactly the health bar the page tells you to sit at.
audit.corrected: Radiant Blast named with its 900 range, slow and resist shred; Starfire Spellblade named as the reset that punishes low health; the 'she cannot do anything' framing replaced with the real trade she is looking for.
sources: champ-data/_kits/kayle.json (Q Radiant Blast: range 900, CD 12/11/10/9/8, 'slowing, damaging, and reducing the resistances of all hit'; E Starfire Spellblade: CD 8/7.5/7/6.5/6, autoReset, 'bonus damage proportionate to their missing health')

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one cooldown number appears anywhere on the page, and the full layer's entire commit rule is "engage only on Divine Judgment's cooldown" without saying what that cooldown is.
audit.why: Divine Judgment is 160/120/80s — at rank 1 that is nearly three minutes, so 'bait it and go' is a once-per-lane plan, not a rhythm. The numbers that actually govern the lane are Celestial Blessing at a flat 15s and Radiant Blast at 12s rank 1: those are the two windows where a melee-form Kayle genuinely cannot answer a step-up. And your own swap is a flat 6s, so a gated Shock Blast in cannon form means no Thundering Blow for six seconds.
audit.corrected: Divine Judgment 160/120/80s, Celestial Blessing 15s, Radiant Blast 12/11/10/9/8s and your own 6s swap written into the spikes, mid and the cooldown block.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart reads Jayce, Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Jayce, Kayle, Kayle — it hands Kayle levels 3 through 5 and then hands Jayce level 6 back. The page's own prose says the exact opposite: whys[2] calls levels 3-5 "my hardest favor window", and whys[4] calls level 6 "a non-spike for me... neither of us can force the all-in".
audit.why: The two stages the chart flips are the two the prose is most emphatic about, and it flips both the wrong way. A reader glancing at the chart is told to play scared at his strongest levels and brave at his flattest one.
audit.corrected: Levels 2 and 3 to Jayce, Levels 4-5 and Level 6 to Skill, first item and 2+ items left with Kayle — giving Jayce, Jayce, Jayce, Skill, Skill, Kayle, Kayle, which is what the prose describes.
sources: content whys[2], whys[3] ('softens to a coinflip'), whys[4], whys[5], whys[6]

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's itemization line says "Anti-heal (Oblivion Orb / Executioner's) early" without saying what heals, and the content layer never mentions her sustain at all.
audit.why: Celestial Blessing is a flat 15s heal on herself and the nearest ally with 900 range. Against a poke lane that is the whole counterplay: every 15 seconds she erases a chunk of Shock Blast chip from tower range. Grievous Wounds is not generic advice here, it is a direct answer to a specific 15-second timer, and it needs to arrive on the first back, not 'early'.
audit.corrected: Celestial Blessing named with its 15s cooldown, and the anti-heal buy tied to it in the mid block.
sources: champ-data/_kits/kayle.json (W Celestial Blessing: CD 15, range 900, heal)

notes: The content layer named zero Kayle abilities across seven whys, four spikes and three prose blocks — Radiant Blast, Celestial Blessing, Starfire Spellblade and Divine Ascent all went unnamed, and Divine Judgment appeared only in the full layer. Worse, the page twice asserts Kayle has "no way to punish" Jayce and "no tool to trade back at level 2". Radiant Blast is 900 range, pierces, slows, and reduces resistances on a 12s rank-1 cooldown, which is more reach than the step-up the page tells you to take freely. Starfire Spellblade is an auto reset whose bonus damage scales with the target's MISSING health, so she is strongest against exactly the poked-down Jayce the page assumes is safe. LEVEL CHART: the chart gave Kayle levels 3, 4-5 and first item and gave Jayce level 6, while the prose calls 3-5 "my hardest favor window" and level 6 "a non-spike... neither of us can force the all-in" — the two flipped stages are the two the prose is loudest about. Corrected to Jayce/Jayce/Jayce/Skill/Skill/Kayle/Kayle. Cooldowns added: Divine Judgment 160/120/80s, Celestial Blessing 15s flat, Radiant Blast 12/11/10/9/8s, Starfire Spellblade 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s. Anti-heal retimed from a vague "early" to the first back, tied to the 15s heal.
